filed_outflow.formula: (total expenses minus total administrative expenses) / net assets at the beginning of the plan year * 100
filed_outflow.label: filed outflow proxy
filed_outflow.source: Schedule H totals of the plan's Form 5500 for plan year 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, from the plan record
filed_outflow.what: total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, an upper bound on benefit payments while Schedule H line 2e is not in the record

match.layers: The structural verdict reads the dealing terms on record (cells 3.1, 3.3, 2.7, plan-independent). The scenario verdict is ILLUSTRATIVE (the plan's filed outflow proxy as the base demand and the turnover assumptions as the stress, against the same capacity, per plan).
reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity, whereas this wrapper deals quarterly with a 5% cap per quarter on outstanding shares. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure: CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).

Facts missing for a structural verdict: gating history (no gating, suspension or postponement is disclosed, but the tendered-versus-accepted amounts are not printed: the Sep-2024 offer was fully utilized at its cap with proration, if any, not stated (the completed-tender rule)). The verdict stays partial until they are read from the filings.

Capacity: 5% per quarter on outstanding shares: at most 20% of the position per year. This is a FUND-level cap shared by every holder, so the plan's position is served only while offers are not oversubscribed.

Filed outflow proxy (Schedule H, plan year 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31): 11.5% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity, the plan's total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, applied to the position. Adequate headroom at the filed rate if offers are not prorated.

Slider assumption (illustrative): 7.2% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity, from tail turnover 20%/yr on the 14.9% of accounts that are separated and active turnover 5%/yr on the rest. Shown beside the filed rate, not blended with it. Within 60% of wrapper capacity at these turnover assumptions.

Scenario verdict (ILLUSTRATIVE, this plan): conditional. No rung fired: the filed outflow proxy 11.5% and the stressed demand 16.6% of the position per year both stay within the annual wrapper capacity 20% (binding cap 5% per quarter on outstanding shares (3.1), quarterly offers (3.1), program active as of 2025-07-31 (3.1), gating history not on record (3.3)). Per quarter: filed 2.9% and stressed 4.2% of the position against the 5% cap. Proration assumption: an oversubscribed offer is filled pro rata and the unfilled remainder waits for the next window.

Schedule H benefit-payment line 2e is not yet in the plan record. The filed outflow proxy (total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets) stands in for it as the base demand, and the turnover assumptions are the stress around it.
